snippet.title: Project Forestation | Gameplay Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Welcome to the nostalgic adventure of the famous blue hedgehog! As part of the SAGE 2025 event, we would like to present to you our new demo version of our game which is inspired by the games of the early 2000s (Sonic Adventure 1-2, Sonic Heroes).

Our game is being developed as a fan-inspired project based on the 3rd season of the anime "Sonic X". In this demo, you will be able to experience improved gameplay (compared to the demo from SAGE 2024) on one of the levels we are currently working on. We are open to criticism since we are newcomers to game development and wish to provide players with the best possible experience given our current abilities. Therefore, please do not hesitate to report any issues you encounter with during your gameplay. Any bug reports will be as good as gold to us. Enjoy the game and have a great time at SAGE!

Download from GameJolt:
https://gamejolt.com/games/forestation/918619
